mike: good timeline. main audience split: product PMs (cost predictability) and infra teams (latency knobs).

raul: copy variants for A/B: A) "Predictable unit economics for shipped features" B) "Meet latency SLAs without large bills". we'll send both to email capture test.

anya: webinar: 25m hands-on tuning (caching+batches), 20m panel w/ customer, 15m live Q&A. CTA: download benchmark kit + config repo.

mike: design asks: hero PNG (1200x628), 3 microcards (chat/search/rerank), and a 10s GIF showing latency drop after batching.

dina: supporting stats to cite: prefix cache = ~23% token reduction on search slice; batching at 150 qps = ~16% cost reduction. i'll pin runs and upload CSVs.

raul: routing rules: webinar signups with >30 seats -> AE; kit downloads with Company domain -> SDR follow-up; others -> nurture sequence.

anya: analytics: track headline variant, kit download->trial conversion, AE handoffs. also capture top-2 use-case selection on form for segmentation.

mike: action items: dina final CSV by EOD, design comps by Mon AM, raul routing & GTM tags by Tue. i'll draft short announcement copy after hero lands.
